en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact European town with dense rows of gabled houses and tiled roofs in the foreground, and a mix of larger brick buildings, factory chimneys emitting smoke, and a distant water tower in the background. The settlement is surrounded by gentle rolling hills. The architecture appears late‑19th to early‑20th century, with multi‑story townhouses and industrial buildings. No visible caption or written text can be seen on the image itself.
